findings.statement: CA9 is the top convergence gene: tumour-up in RNA [gene=CA9; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=6.312] and protein [gene=CA9; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.269], replicated in TCGA-KIRC and robust to purity extrapolation. Safety caveat: the vital-organ proteome shows stomach enrichment [gene=CA9; type=normal_proteome; source=DATASET:GTEX-PROTEOME; vital_protein_ts_max=5.19].

CD70 is a membrane target absent in normal kidney and up in tumour at protein [gene=CD70; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.421] and RNA [gene=CD70; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=4.464], with TCGA replication. It is not enriched in vital organs [gene=CD70; type=normal_proteome; source=DATASET:GTEX-PROTEOME; vital_protein_ts_max=0.34], and antibody and ADC programmes exist.

ENPP3 is a surface enzyme up in tumour protein [gene=ENPP3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=1.544] and RNA [gene=ENPP3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=3.895], with no vital-organ enrichment [gene=ENPP3; type=normal_proteome; source=DATASET:GTEX-PROTEOME; vital_protein_ts_max=0.0]. An ADC (AGS-16C3F) reached phase 2.

NNMT is tumour-intrinsic and up in protein [gene=NNMT; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.709] and RNA [gene=NNMT; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=4.67]. Higher expression is associated with worse survival in TCGA-KIRC, which makes it a prognostic biomarker with a metabolic-target rationale.

SCARB1 (SR-B1) ranks first in the target profile: up in protein [gene=SCARB1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=1.837] and RNA [gene=SCARB1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=2.974], replicated in TCGA. It is a membrane cholesterol-uptake receptor consistent with the lipid-laden ccRCC phenotype, but it is also expressed in normal tissues, so selectivity is not established.

SLC16A3 (MCT4, lactate exporter) is up in protein [gene=SLC16A3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=2.279] and RNA [gene=SLC16A3; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=3.435], replicated in TCGA, consistent with HIF-driven glycolysis. Cis copy-number effect is positive.

COXFA4L2 (NDUFA4L2) is a strong HIF-axis tumour marker, up in protein [gene=COXFA4L2; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=3.768] and RNA [gene=COXFA4L2; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=6.752], replicated in TCGA. It is a mitochondrial protein, so it is better suited as a tissue biomarker than as a target.

ALDOB is lost with proximal-tubule identity: down in protein [gene=ALDOB; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=-2.273] and RNA [gene=ALDOB; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=-7.028]. Low expression is associated with worse survival in TCGA. It is a diagnostic and prognostic marker, not a target.

PSAT1 tops the biomarker profile: down in tumour at protein [gene=PSAT1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-PROTEOME; layer=protein; log2fc=-1.963] and RNA [gene=PSAT1; type=omics_de; source=DATASET:CPTAC-CCRCC-RNA; layer=rna; log2fc=-3.867]. Within TCGA-KIRC, higher expression predicts worse survival, a paradoxical pattern. Use it as a prognostic marker with caution.

VHL is the disease driver, with recurrent somatic mutation across the combined CPTAC and TCGA cohort [gene=VHL; type=somatic_recurrence; source=DATASET:SOMATIC-CPTAC-TCGA; freq=0.483], plus frequent 3p copy-number loss with a positive cis dosage effect. Loss of VHL explains HIF activation and the up-regulated CA9, NDUFA4L2, SLC16A3 and NNMT programme. Its own RNA and protein changes are small, so it is not a DE-based biomarker.

caveats: Several statements on TCGA replication, purity, survival direction and cis copy number rely on the convergence_ranking summary rows and were not individually re-queried or numerically annotated.

CPTAC cohort is small (110 tumours, 75 paired RNA and 84 paired proteome), and bulk tissue includes stroma and immune cells; purity-sensitive genes such as FCER1G and TYROBP were deliberately not promoted.
PRISM and DepMap show no selective ccRCC dependency for the top candidates, and 2D cell lines miss HIF-2 biology, so target claims rest on expression and tractability, not functional dependency.
CA9 shows stomach enrichment in the GTEx vital-organ proteome (TS at or above 4), a safety concern; the GTEx proteome lacks kidney, and absence of detection is not proof of absence.
Down-regulated genes (ALDOB, PSAT1) reflect loss of tubule identity and metabolic reprogramming, and are biomarkers rather than targets.
Phospho results are gene-level and were not adjusted for protein abundance here; kinase activity was not examined.
